original_claim.instructions: Classify what the original page statement communicates in this supplied context. Choose only whether it asserts existing behavior, states a requirement, is ambiguous, or lacks enough information. Do not evaluate legal correctness.

criteria.asserts_existing_behavior: It clearly states implemented deterministic behavior exists now.
criteria.states_requirement: It only prescribes behavior future consumer code should implement.
criteria.ambiguous: It could reasonably be read either way.
criteria.insufficient_context: The provided text does not support a determinate reading.

revised_claim.instructions: Classify what the revised statement communicates in this supplied context. Choose only whether it clearly distinguishes a requirement from implemented behavior, still asserts existing behavior, is ambiguous, or lacks enough information. Do not evaluate legal correctness.

criteria.clear_requirement_not_verified_behavior: It prescribes a consumer requirement and explicitly says this collection does not implement or verify it.
criteria.asserts_existing_behavior: It claims the behavior is currently implemented.
criteria.ambiguous: It could reasonably be read either way.
criteria.insufficient_context: The provided text does not support a determinate reading.

advisory_reviews.host_disposition: Advisory wording review agrees with the deterministic repository finding; it does not establish that a consumer exists or functions.

outcome.confirmed_documentation_defect: All eight pages described missing-field handling as code behavior despite no corresponding consumer implementation in this collection.
outcome.repair: Rephrased the text on all pages as a mandatory consumer-code requirement and stated explicitly that this collection does not implement or verify the gate.
outcome.reason: The only frozen-screen disagreement remains a model miss on absent party_b evidence. No question wording or expectation was changed to fit the observed answer.
outcome.integration_follow_up: A future consumer must reject absent or empty required fields before calling Jev and return unknown. Verify that behavior in consumer-level tests before documenting it as implemented.
